subject: general
question: Which of the following teams set the 4x100m relay record at the National Relay Carnival 2025?

options.text: Gurindervir Singh, Animesh Kujur, Manikanta Hoblidar and Amlan Borgohain
Archana, Dhanalakshmi, Manikanta Hoblidar and Amlan Borgohain

solution:
The correct answer is __**Gurindervir Singh, Animesh Kujur, Manikanta Hoblidar, and Amlan Borgohain**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Relay Carnival 2025** witnessed a historic moment when the team of **Gurindervir Singh, Animesh Kujur, Manikanta Hoblidar, and Amlan Borgohain** set a new record in the **4x100m relay**.
 
• This team demonstrated exceptional coordination, speed, and skill to achieve this milestone, showcasing their prowess in track and field events.
 
• Each member of the team has a strong athletic background:
 
 
• **Gurindervir Singh** is known for his explosive starts and is considered one of India’s premier sprinters.
 
• **Animesh Kujur** has consistently performed in national-level competitions and is celebrated for his endurance and speed.
 
• **Manikanta Hoblidar** is recognized for his smooth transitions and reliability in relay events.
 
• **Amlan Borgohain**, already a record holder in individual sprints, added significant strength to the team.
 
 
 
• The team’s performance not only broke the previous record but also set a benchmark for upcoming relay teams in India.
 
• This achievement highlights the importance of teamwork, precision, and rigorous training in relay events, contributing significantly to India’s athletic legacy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Relay Carnival:**

 
 
• The National Relay Carnival is an annual event that aims to promote relay races and bring together the best athletes from across the country.
 
• It serves as a platform for talent identification and preparation for international competitions such as the Asian Games and Olympics.
 
• The carnival includes a variety of relay events, including the **4x100m**, **4x400m**, and mixed relay categories.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Relay Events:**
 
 
• Relay races require excellent coordination among team members, precise baton exchanges, and strategic planning.
 
• They test not just individual speed but also teamwork and collective effort.
 
• Relay events are a prominent part of global athletic competitions like the **Olympics** and **IAAF World Championships**.
 
 
 
• **Indian Athletics Development:**
 
 
• India has made significant strides in athletics, with increasing investments in training facilities, coaching, and international exposure.
 
• Initiatives like the **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)** have been instrumental in nurturing athletic talent.
 
• Indian sprinters, including those in relay teams, have started to make their presence felt in international events.
 
 
 
• **Notable Achievements in Indian Relay History:**
 
 
• India’s relay teams have consistently performed well in regional competitions like the **Asian Games**.
 
• With the emergence of athletes like **Amlan Borgohain** and others, the country is poised to challenge world records in relay events.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Team Composition:** The selection of relay team members is based on individual performances, compatibility, and reliability during baton exchanges.
 
• **Training Regimen:** Relay teams undergo specialized training focusing on baton exchange techniques, race strategies, and synchronization.
 
• **Global Standards:** India’s relay teams are striving to meet international standards, with time benchmarks set by leading countries like the USA and Jamaica.
 
• **Future Prospects:** With continued investment and focus, Indian relay teams have the potential to excel in global competitions and bring laurels to the nation.
